name: resqnet-monorepo
description: ResQNet - Offline-First Disaster Emergency Reporting and Rescue Coordination Platform

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
